prompts.animation:
Create one continuous 3-second locked low-angle shot from the supplied Start Frame. Animate only the single Delicja that is already suspended in mid-air near the sharp center foreground. It begins at its exact visible position and immediately falls straight downward under ordinary Earth gravity. Its motion must obey normal physical weight, acceleration and momentum for a small soft sponge biscuit: no hovering, levitation, slow motion, sudden sideways propulsion or magical motion. The biscuit may rotate slightly while falling, then strikes the wet hard ground naturally, makes at most one very small low bounce or short wobble caused by the uneven rubble, and comes fully to rest. After settling, it simply remains lying motionless on the ground for the rest of the shot. It must not bounce repeatedly, roll away, stand on edge, float back upward, disappear, dissolve or transform.

Every other Delicja already lying on the ground stays exactly where it is and remains motionless. No new biscuits enter, fall, appear, spawn, duplicate or multiply anywhere in the frame. Preserve the exact number, appearance and Jaffa-cake construction of all biscuits: one pale sponge base with a smooth chocolate cap, never a sandwich cookie. Keep the camera completely fixed and preserve the focus plane, wet rubble, rain, ruined Dom Kultury, lighting and distant blurred survivor group exactly. The people remain blurred and still; nobody approaches the camera or reacts significantly. No repair of the building, new destruction, magic, dialogue, packaging, subtitles, watermark or cut.
